Question Choices: How many branches does the graph of y = 1/x have?
Hints: One branch lies in the first quadrant.;The other lies in the third.
Solution: The domain splits into x<0 and x>0. Each interval gives one continuous branch: x<0 has y<0 in Quadrant III and x>0 has y>0 in Quadrant I. Thus there are two branches.
